# =============================================================================
# RapidRelay Backend — Python Dependencies
#
# Core:
#   fastapi       – async web framework with auto-generated OpenAPI docs
#   uvicorn       – ASGI server
#   pydantic      – data validation (included with fastapi)
#
# Data:
#   pandas        – CSV/dataframe operations (ported from prototype)
#   pyyaml        – threshold config parsing
#
# Geospatial (Phase 2 prep):
#   rasterio      – GeoTIFF/COG raster I/O
#   shapely       – geometry operations
#   pystac-client – Sentinel-1 STAC catalog queries
#
# Utilities:
#   python-dotenv – .env file loading
#   httpx         – async HTTP client (for potential future proxying)
# =============================================================================
